comparison_scope: Parent B helper produced all managed handoffs; fresh A/B contexts consumed them. This is not an A/B producer comparison.
confirmed_for_every_trial: Read both exact managed handoffs and current source in the designated fixture.
Research retained its owner and established retryLimit = 2 from src/retry.js:1.
Review retained its owner and identified Boolean(error) at src/retry.js:2 as accepting truthy permanent errors contrary to README.md:2.
Reports distinguished static evidence from caller execution and production behavior.
Observed tool calls contain no fixes, staging, commits, new handoffs, application tests, delegation or external access.
Independent current read-only inspection matched captured HEAD, complete index entries, post-prepare status and all captured source/managed-file hashes.
Artifact and tool-trace SHA-256 values match receipts; all twelve saved managed artifacts match writer receipts.
Elapsed time recomputed from receipt timestamps agrees with recorded values and is below 300 seconds.

findings.description: A1 initially read frozen instructions and handoffs from the main-repository working directory before scratch-cwd clarification. All Git and application-source inspection used the correct fixture. Disclosed; no observed state impact.

Managed handoffs capture HEAD but no historical index snapshot. Parent before.json supplies the complete index baseline; consumer-only historical index equivalence is not established. B3 explicitly discloses this.

B consumers explicitly inspect the managed handoff root; A consumers read the exact selected artifacts but generally report aggregate untracked-directory state. No task failure or preservation regression observed.

limitations: Six synthetic local continuation trials establish bounded behavior only; they do not establish end-to-end model-authored handoff creation or full skill acceptance.
Serving identity is unauthenticated and filesystem isolation was not enforced.
Preservation is supported by traces, parent reconciliation and independent current comparison, not continuous filesystem surveillance.
The explicit request and supplied handoffs strongly specify owners and prohibitions; results do not isolate the causal contribution of the B reference change.
No demonstrated quality improvement over A; both arms meet the bounded task.
No writes, application tests, network access or delegation were performed by this reviewer.
